FAQ

Questions, answered

How long does setup take?
Most teams connect their first source and see live data within twenty minutes.
Is my data secure?
Data is encrypted in transit and at rest. SOC 2 Type II and GDPR documentation are available on request.
Can I migrate from my current tool?
Yes. Import wizards and a migration team are included on Team and Enterprise plans.
What happens if I exceed my plan?
We never cut you off mid-month. We will email you before any change is applied.
